cardo systems - packtalk neo motorcycle.description: The Cardo Packtalk Neo Motorcycle Bluetooth Communication System Headset is designed for riders who want advanced group communication, premium audio, and reliable connectivity on every ride. Featuring 2nd-generation Dynamic Mesh Communication (DMC), the system allows up to 15 riders to connect seamlessly while automatically reconnecting riders who temporarily drop out of range. Rider-to-rider communication reaches distances of up to 1.6 km (1 mile), making it ideal for group rides and touring. Equipped with 40mm JBL speakers, the Packtalk Neo delivers clear and powerful sound for music, calls, and GPS navigation even at highway speeds. With Natural Voice Operation, riders can control the device hands-free by simply saying “Hey Cardo,” allowing full control while keeping both hands on the handlebars.
